rpm.versions: resolved at build; inventory emitted; repository snapshot not pinned

verification.registry_check: GET index and linux/amd64 manifest; computed SHA-256 and compared header and descriptor; no layers fetched
verification.python_check: official uv release metadata URL and SHA-256 only; archive not downloaded

blockers: No final image or real authenticated signature/SBOM/provenance; future execution required
Trust policy, exact source commit, Sigstore TrustedRoot hash and signing/publication environment require human approval
Explicit human deployment authorization and real compatibility/persistence tests required

security_model.runtime: rootless Podman with Distrobox 1.8.2.5 host integration
security_model.container_selinux_labeling: disabled by Distrobox; host Enforcing is not container confinement
security_model.home_and_runtime_sharing: original HOME and /run/user may remain shared; user sockets can be visible
security_model.m4: separate restricted runtime or disposable VM according to risk; not implemented

cosign.sha256_source: GitHub official release asset metadata; binary not downloaded

bootstrap.provenance_assurance: workflow-asserted custom provenance, authenticated by Cosign if future signing succeeds; not independent builder evidence or a SLSA level

image_signature.format: Cosign 3.1.4 new-bundle in-toto v1; explicit typed verify-attestation
